assign.request: UX rethink pass 2 on /imagine/feeds/ per reviewer-brief.md — is this the best shape this page could have?

log.msg: task opened. Realm: feeds — video (lazy YouTube picker), data (one data.json, 3 renderings + filter), live (Open-Meteo weather, polling). Landing page.js already uses index:true + width:large + previews() tile wall (fixed 2026-09-04). All three preview cards currently show only an icon (smart_display/table_chart/cloud), no real still — this looks like the realm's single biggest lever per the known finding.

FIVE SENTENCES (before): what=three cards (icon+truncated text) above a duplicate plain link list bug already fixed 2026-09-04, now just three icon cards. use=click a card, lands on a real sub-page. goal=see three ways this site handles content it does not author. hard=2/5, legible but forgettable -- Video/Data/Live read as three generic icons, nothing distinguishes them at a glance. better=replace the icon in each card with a real screenshot of the thing (poster, building wall, weather rows) -- the biggest repeated win from round 1.

before shots taken (1280/3440), 0 console errors. Measured 3440: contentRight 1583/3440=46.0pct width used, dead space 1856px (site-wide columns-host known issue, not this page), content height (own column body, not doc.scrollHeight) 340.8px. 1280: contentRight 1172/1280=91.6pct, content height 255.75px.

VISUAL FIX (kept): video/data/live each got a preview(nav) override -- a real screenshot (Steve Jobs mid-talk poster, the real 20-building card wall, the real 5-city weather rows with real numbers) replaces the bare icon, same pattern as design/ and gallery/ (this round nearly universal win). New files: public/imagine/feeds/shots/{video,data,live}.jpg. Trap found+fixed while building the live shot: .feeds-weather-row is justify-content:space-between, so a wide capture centre-crops (object-fit:cover, 16:10 thumb) into the dead gap between columns and reads as a blank card -- fixed by shooting that one at a narrow (420px) viewport so the row content is already close to the thumb aspect before the crop. Logged in doc/decisions.md.

LAYOUT alternative -- built expand, reverted. Landing page is a 3-card wall of heterogeneous children (menu-of-children shape), which round-1 already disproved the 3-column card for five times over, so I did not re-build that one (one line, per brief). Instead tried the paging-vocabulary surface change: expand (ui-accordion, one row per child growing in place) instead of launch (previews() opening a new column, the existing behaviour). Built it for real in feeds/page.js, shot + measured at 3440, then reverted. Numbers: collapsed, all 3 real stills vanish behind a bare icon+title row; opened, one child alone stood 480px tall vs ~340-407px for all three as cards (stills included); the other two showed nothing. Also fails on paging its own documented terms: /imagine/paging/ names expand wrong when the thing opened has children of its own and no url to link to -- true of video/data/live, and feeds readme.md already promises the opposite (every variation is a real page you can link to). Kept: previews() tile wall (launch), unchanged mechanism, now with real stills.

AFTER measurements at 3440 (kept shape): width used 46.0pct (unchanged, dead space is the known site-wide columns-host issue, not this page), dead space 1856px (unchanged), content height 406.9px (up from 340.8px -- the 16:10 thumbs are taller than the two-line description text they replaced; still a small fraction of any real viewport). 1280: content height 320.2px (up from 255.75px). Invariants: no content at x:0 (pass, left edge 210/432px), no prose past ~40em (pass, intro wraps ~530px well under 640px), no framed box touching a container edge (pass, cards have margin on all sides in every shot).
PERSISTENCE: none -- grep for store()/localStorage under public/imagine/feeds/ returns nothing. live/ polls a public API every 60s but never writes anything; nothing here needs baseline().

UI-TEST: Feeds card (real still) -> Video column -> clicked the jobs talk row -> 0 iframes before play -> clicked .feeds-play -> 1 iframe, src https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/UF8uR6Z6KLc?autoplay=1&rel=0. Zero console errors across all 9 steps. Separate console sweep: 0 errors at 1280 and 3440 on all 8 feeds urls (landing, video, video/jobs, data, data/cards, data/tree, data/table, live).

FIVE SENTENCES (after): what=three small labs of content this repo does not author, each shown by a real photo of itself (a speaker mid-talk, a wall of building cards, a live weather board) instead of a generic icon. use=click any of the three real-looking cards, land on that lab, and (on Video) click the play button to swap the poster for the real embed. goal=leave knowing three concrete ways to embed a video, render one dataset three ways, and poll a public API safely. hard=1/5, obvious at a glance -- each card now shows the actual thing, not a category label. better=the data.json wall would read even faster with 3-4 named building photos instead of text-only cards one level in (a further layer, not required tonight).

assign.outcome: **Real stills replace three bare icons; `expand` tried and reverted.** `/imagine/feeds/`'s three cards (`video`, `data`, `live`) each now show a real screenshot of the actual thing via a `preview(nav)` override — a speaker mid-talk, the real 20-building card wall, the real 5-city weather board — instead of a generic Material icon. Tried the `expand` surface-change alternative on the landing page for real (an accordion in place of `previews()`'s launch-to-a-column click); reverted with measurements: collapsed it hid every real still, and opened, one child alone stood 480px tall at 3440 vs ~407px for all three as cards. Zero console errors at 1280/3440 across all 8 realm urls; the play-button gesture proved end to end with `ui-test`. No persistence in this realm.
